The price type of the Nth pricing module. Valid values:

- Hour: hourly price.

- Usage: usage.

- Month: monthly price.

- Year: yearly price.

> Obtain the price type by calling the [DescribePricingModule](~~96469~~) operation.

element_fields.description_en:
The configuration of the Nth pricing module. The value of N can be an integer from 1 to 50. The configuration is in the "AA:aa,BB:bb" format. In this format, AA and BB are the property codes of the pricing module, and aa and bb are the property values.

> Obtain the configuration by calling the [DescribePricingModule](~~96469~~) operation.
element_fields.description_zh:
第n个计价模块的配置，n的取值范围为（1~50），格式：“AA:aa,BB:bb”，其中AA,BB分别为计价模块属性标识，aa,bb分别为计价模块属性的属性值。

> 可通过[DescribePricingModule](~~96469~~)接口获取Module参数。
